tasks.short: Prepare philosophy and religion course materials

steps.what: Choose course aims, readings, interpretive framing and assignment requirements
Prepare syllabi, assignments and handouts from the teaching brief

loop.input: verified teaching brief and selected source passages
loop.check: Lecturer checks doctrinal and philosophical accuracy, rival interpretations, question answerability and learning alignment
loop.stop: One revision then manual drafting for unsupported or distorted interpretation
loop.why_not_simpler: Open assignments and interpretive explanations require prose beyond fixed template fields

steps.what: Check and accept the exact course materials for teaching use

tasks.design: Use native {DOCS} templates and a bounded draft from lecturer-selected sources and requirements. The lecturer checks interpretations and accepts each exact material version; student publication is separate.
tasks.previous_blocker: Templates do not compose varied interpretive teaching prose.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded draft can organise supplied content without owning academic choices.
tasks.still_hard: Avoiding flattened traditions, invented citations and misleading questions.
tasks.human_edge: Choose the intellectual framing and test whether an exercise teaches it.
tasks.altitude: A little less initial prose preparation; academic judgement stays intact.

evidence.claim: EduGenAI is a chat-platform pilot for university use; it does not establish accurate philosophy materials or time savings.
This source-bound material design and saving are unmeasured assumptions.

assumptions: Boundary is material preparation, excluding research, course approval and live teaching.

The lecturer produces aims, student level, selected passage references, dates, assessment requirements and intended interpretations in s1; full selection and capture time remains. Missing or disputed sources require manual drafting.
Test existing document and learning-system templates before custom integration.
No generated bibliographic claim is accepted without checking its actual source.
unknowns: Existing reusable materials and permitted drafting tool
Actual review time for interpretive errors
research_questions: Does drafting reduce total material preparation after checking competing interpretations?

already_counted.description: Brief capture and final academic checks

approvals.approved_version: Exact source passages, syllabus, assignments and handout snapshot; edits void acceptance

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R89.5 gross10.5 minus5 upkeep gives net5.5. Range0-2 allows substantial interpretation checking or extensive existing reuse.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Stay current in philosophy and religion

steps.what: Read current literature, discuss developments with colleagues and participate in conferences

tasks.design: Keep substantive reading and professional exchange with the lecturer. Search aids around {DOCS} do not replace understanding an argument or participating in debate.
tasks.previous_blocker: Scholarly learning requires direct engagement with competing arguments.
tasks.enabler_now: Topic summaries can orient a search but do not establish equivalent learning in less time.
tasks.still_hard: Assessing unfamiliar arguments and changes in interpretation.
tasks.altitude: Learning time and scholarly responsibility remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Scopus AI provides topic summaries and foundational papers; that capability does not establish reduced substantive learning time.

assumptions: Boundary is scholarly learning, not a separate bibliography compilation task.
The lecturer reads and evaluates literature during s1; no free verified relevance or interpretation labels are assumed.
Inspect native catalogue tools before custom work; no additional system is proposed.
Zero upkeep because no new tool or process is introduced.
research_questions: Which discovery gaps matter without shortening substantive reading?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0; substantive learning remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Capture attendance and verify authorised grades and student record identifiers
Transfer required entries and prepare attendance and grade records
Resolve exceptions and accept the exact student record updates

tasks.design: Configure a native transfer from {LMS} to {OTHER}, the student record system, before custom integration. Retain attendance capture, authorised-grade verification, exception handling and acceptance.
tasks.previous_blocker: Required records may be entered into more than one system.
tasks.enabler_now: Stable identifiers and explicit mappings can remove repeated transfer work.
tasks.still_hard: Wrong student links, revised grades and ambiguous attendance.
tasks.human_edge: Resolve discrepancies without changing the examiner's decision.
tasks.altitude: Less duplicate transfer; record and grade responsibilities remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Radboud requires Brightspace grades also to be published in OSIRIS, illustrating a dual-record requirement without establishing this institution's savings.
The proposed verified transfer and time split are unmeasured design assumptions.

assumptions: Boundary is record maintenance; assessment decisions and student attendance time remain separate.

The lecturer captures student identifier, session date, attendance observation, assessment identifier, authorised grade and result version in s1; its full 40 percent includes capture and checking. The authorised examiner produces results through separately counted assessment work.

The records administrator produces course and student mappings, allowed status codes and amendment rules before transfer, with additional maintenance counted. Missing or conflicting fields pause transfer for manual resolution.
Test native exports and imports first; existing automatic transfer earns no new saving.
unknowns: Existing transfer capability and record requirements
research_questions: Does native transfer remove duplicate entry after capture and exception work are counted?

approvals.approved_version: Exact student identifiers, attendance entries, authorised result versions and update batch; edits void acceptance

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R65 gross35 minus6 upkeep gives net29. Range0-8 allows an already configured transfer or frequent amendments to remove most opportunity.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Write articles and books by developing and revising original scholarly arguments

tasks.design: Keep original argument development and scholarly writing with the lecturer in {DOCS}. No routine drafting baseline is assumed for producing the intellectual contribution.
tasks.previous_blocker: The prose is part of discovering and defending the argument.
tasks.enabler_now: Text generation alone does not establish equivalent scholarship in less time.
tasks.still_hard: Original interpretation, evidential accuracy and engaging objections.
tasks.human_edge: Own the contribution and defend every claim.
tasks.altitude: Scholarly writing time and authorship remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Original scholarly composition combines reasoning and prose; no routine text-production saving is assumed.

assumptions: Boundary is scholarly manuscript composition, excluding separate bibliographies, publishing administration and peer review.
The lecturer produces and verifies arguments and source interpretations during s1; no free structured thesis or verified citation set is assumed.
Existing document and reference tools suffice; no custom model is proposed.
Zero upkeep because no new workflow is introduced.
research_questions: Which writing actions are mechanical without constituting the scholarly contribution?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0; original argument and prose development remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Less duplicate record transfer and some material drafting where verified inputs exist.
reach: Work with records and instructional specialists on clear boundaries
role.ambitious_version: A lecturer with clearer teaching materials and records while retaining scholarly and educational judgement.
